requirement.original: 系统性修复锦里被同时归纳为entertainment和attraction的bug，save脚本加入验证系统，如果存在time完全相同的两个poi且不都是optional，报警；如果time有重叠，提醒
requirement.clarified: Add cross-agent POI time validation to plan-validate.py to detect duplicate POIs across different agent files (attractions, entertainment, shopping, meals). Save.py already calls plan-validate.py, so adding validation logic there will automatically protect all saves.
requirement.what: Add POI time conflict detection to plan-validate.py check_cross_agent() function
requirement.why: Jinli Ancient Street appears in both attractions.json and entertainment.json with identical time slots (16:12-17:30), causing data duplication. No validation currently exists to detect cross-agent POI time conflicts.

included: Add POI time conflict detection in check_cross_agent()
Rule 1: If two POIs have IDENTICAL time AND both are NOT optional → HIGH severity error
Rule 2: If two POIs have OVERLAPPING time → MEDIUM severity warning
Support POI sources: attractions, entertainment, shopping, meals
Compare POIs across all agent combinations per day

success_criteria: plan-validate.py detects Jinli duplicate (identical time, both non-optional) as HIGH severity
Validation distinguishes between identical time (ERROR) and overlapping time (WARNING)
Optional POIs are excluded from identical-time check
Save.py automatically blocks saves when HIGH severity POI conflicts detected
constraints: Must not break existing validation logic
Must preserve backward compatibility with current JSON formats
Must handle missing 'time' or 'optional' fields gracefully

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Jinli Ancient Street appears in both attractions.json and entertainment.json with identical time (16:12-17:30), both marked as non-optional
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: plan-validate.py check_cross_agent() function lacks POI time conflict detection. Current cross-agent checks only validate: day count consistency, date consistency, location consistency, budget sum consistency. No logic exists to detect when the same POI (or different POIs with identical times) appears across multiple agent files.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: No specific commit - validation gap exists since plan-validate.py creation
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: check_cross_agent() was designed for structural consistency (dates, locations, budgets) but not content-level conflict detection (POI time overlaps)
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Allows timeline agent or individual agents to create conflicting schedules where user is expected to be in two places at the same time. This violates the fundamental constraint that a person can only be at one location at any given time.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Validation gap exists since scripts/plan-validate.py creation

git_rationale.root_cause: check_cross_agent() function lacked POI time conflict detection. Validation was limited to structural consistency (day counts, dates, locations, budget sums) but did not detect content-level scheduling conflicts where same POI or different POIs with identical/overlapping times appeared across multiple agent files.
git_rationale.root_cause_commit: No specific commit - validation gap exists since plan-validate.py creation
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: check_cross_agent() was designed for structural consistency validation, not content-level conflict detection. POI time overlaps were considered an edge case not initially addressed in validation design.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Added comprehensive POI time conflict detection that: (1) Collects all POIs with time data from attractions, entertainment, shopping, meals per day, (2) Compares all POI pairs across different agents, (3) Detects identical times (HIGH if both non-optional, INFO if optional), (4) Detects overlapping times (MEDIUM severity). This addresses root cause by extending validation from structural to content-level conflict detection.

validation_rules.condition: start1 == start2 AND end1 == end2 AND NOT opt1 AND NOT opt2
validation_rules.message_format: IDENTICAL TIME CONFLICT: '{name1}' ({agent1}) and '{name2}' ({agent2}) both scheduled at {time} (both non-optional)

validation_rules.rule: RULE 1b: Identical Time + At Least One Optional
validation_rules.condition: start1 == start2 AND end1 == end2 AND (opt1 OR opt2)
validation_rules.message_format: Identical time (optional): '{name1}' ({agent1}) and '{name2}' ({agent2}) at {time} (at least one is optional)

validation_rules.condition: start1 < end2 AND start2 < end1 (and NOT identical)

error_handling: Skip POI if time field missing or not dict type
Skip POI if time.start or time.end missing
Skip POI if time values are empty strings
Use .get('optional', False) to handle missing optional field (default: False = non-optional)
